answer: Audits are recorded in echo, queued in sonnet, and canyon publishes the wait time. A farm of 29 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 58 identities per epoch. A farm of 1995 identities would post 1825 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
